title: The Collection for the Saints, Final Instructions

questions.question: Now concerning the collection for the saints: as Paul directed the churches of ____, so the Corinthians are also to do.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 16:1 (ESV): "Now concerning the collection for the saints: as I directed the churches of Galatia, so you also are to do."

questions.question: On what day of the week is each of them to put something aside and store it up, as he may prosper?
options: On the first day of every week
questions.correctAnswer: On the first day of every week
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 16:2 (ESV): "On the first day of every week, each of you is to put something aside and store it up, as he may prosper, so that there will be no collecting when I come."

questions.question: Paul says he will stay in Ephesus until ____, for a wide door for effective work has opened to him, and there are many adversaries.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 16:8-9 (ESV): "But I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost, for a wide door for effective work has opened to me, and there are many adversaries."

questions.question: Paul asks the Corinthians to put whom at ease among them, for he is doing the work of the Lord?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 16:10 (ESV): "When Timothy comes, see that you put him at ease among you, for he is doing the work of the Lord, as I am."

questions.question: Which brother did Paul strongly urge to visit them with the other brothers, but it was not at all his will to come now?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 16:12 (ESV): "Now concerning our brother Apollos, I strongly urged him to visit you with the other brothers, but it was not at all his will to come now. He will come when he has opportunity."

questions.question: Paul commands: "Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like ____, be strong."
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 16:13 (ESV): "Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong."

questions.question: And the very next verse commands: "Let all that you do be done in ____."
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 16:14 (ESV): "Let all that you do be done in love."

questions.question: Whose household was the first converts in Achaia, and had devoted themselves to the service of the saints?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 16:15 (ESV): "Now I urge you, brothers—you know that the household of Stephanas were the first converts in Achaia, and that they have devoted themselves to the service of the saints—"

questions.question: Paul rejoices at the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus, because they made up for the Corinthians' ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 16:17 (ESV): "I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus, because they have made up for your absence,"

questions.question: The churches of Asia send you greetings. Aquila and Prisca, together with the church in their ____, send you hearty greetings in the Lord.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 16:19 (ESV): "The churches of Asia send you greetings. Aquila and Prisca, together with the church in their house, send you hearty greetings in the Lord."

questions.question: All the brothers send you greetings. Greet one another with a holy ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 16:20 (ESV): "All the brothers send you greetings. Greet one another with a holy kiss."

questions.question: Paul writes, "I, Paul, write this greeting with my own ____."
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 16:21 (ESV): "I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand."

questions.question: If anyone has no love for the Lord, let him be ____. Our Lord, come!
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 16:22 (ESV): "If anyone has no love for the Lord, let him be accursed. Our Lord, come!"

questions.question: What is the Aramaic phrase Paul uses at the end of the letter that means "Our Lord, come!"?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 16:22 (ESV): "If anyone has no love for the Lord, let him be accursed. Our Lord, come!" (The word Maranatha is untranslated in some versions, but means "Our Lord, come").

questions.question: Paul ends his first letter to the Corinthians with, "My ____ be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen."
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 16:24 (ESV): "My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen."

key_verse_text: Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong. Let all that you do be done in love.
